_README: Facts SSOT. Follows HARNESS.md. Only status:VERIFIED facts render. All numbers/contacts/rules must be grounded here. No invented estimates. VOLATILE facts must show source + verified date + confirm link. claim/notes are the ENGLISH (base-language) display text; translations for other locales live in messages/<locale>.json under `facts`.

facts.claim: Klook lists a 2026 Busan Fireworks Festival ticket and round-trip shuttle product.
facts.notes: Product identity and package listing checked. Availability, prices, departure details, inclusions and cancellation terms must be confirmed on Klook. Past reviews do not establish current package conditions.

facts.claim: Klook lists a Jinju Namgang Lantern Festival guided tour departing from Busan.
facts.notes: Product page includes a 2026 date selector. It is a tour product, not a standalone festival admission ticket. Confirm the selected date and current package on Klook.

facts.claim: Busan International Film Festival runs from 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-15 at Busan Cinema Center and other official screening venues.

value.venue: Busan Cinema Center and other official screening venues

facts.notes: Official dates and venues verified. Confirm individual screening times, fees and booking with the organizer. Map is an orientation venue, not every screening location.

value.venue: Jinjuseong Fortress and the Namgang River, Jinju

facts.notes: Official dates and venues verified. Confirm program times, charges and reservations with the organizer. No fee or fireworks/drone performance time is asserted.

value.venue: Gwangalli Beach, Igidae and Dongbaekseom, Busan

facts.claim: The e-Arrival Card is conditional. Valid K-ETA holders entering under K-ETA and valid Korean residence-card holders are exempt. A traveler entering with a visa may need the declaration even when also holding K-ETA. Other exceptions exist: use the official navigator for your documents and journey. This is an immigration declaration, separate from customs.
facts.notes: If required, submit free at e-arrivalcard.go.kr from 3 days before arrival, based on Korean Standard Time. It expires 72 hours after submission or once immigration is completed. Keeping the emailed issuance number is helpful; carrying a printed confirmation is not required. Guide: https://www.e-arrivalcard.go.kr/portal/guide/eacGuide.do

facts.claim: Malaysia ordinary-passport holders may enter Korea visa-free for short tourism (up to 3 months). K-ETA approval is required before boarding unless exempt; valid visas and residence cards follow their own entry rules.

value.keta_valid: 3 years or passport expiry, whichever first

facts.notes: K-ETA-eligible travelers aged 17 and under or 65 and over are exempt from mandatory K-ETA. This does not itself exempt them from the e-Arrival Card. K-ETA costs KRW 10,000 plus the online payment fee and is non-refundable. Current approvals are valid for 3 years or until passport expiry, whichever comes first; this is not the allowed length of each stay. Apply early enough to receive approval before boarding. K-ETA assessment can take more than 72 hours; no approval time or entry is guaranteed. Application rules: https://www.k-eta.go.kr/portal/guide/viewetaapplication.do?locale=EN

facts.claim: Mongolian citizens need a C-3-9 short-term tourist visa for Korea (single entry, stay up to 90 days), applied for in person at the Korea Visa Application Center in Ulaanbaatar. Processing is about 5–15 business days.
facts.notes: From 1 April 2026 the application form must be typed and printed — handwritten forms are not accepted. The 6-month bank statement does not need to be translated into Korean, though other documents may. Fees vary by visa type (roughly US$40 for a single-entry short stay) — confirm the current fee at visaforkorea.mn.

facts.claim: Bangladeshi citizens need a C-3-9 short-term tourist visa for Korea (single entry, stay up to 90 days), submitted with a printed barcoded e-Form at the Korean Embassy in Dhaka. Single-entry fee about US$40; processing about 10–15 working days.

value.fee: US$40 single / US$70 double / US$90 multiple

facts.source_name: Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Bangladesh (MOFA)
facts.notes: All applicants must complete the e-Form on visa.go.kr and submit the printed, barcoded form. Bangladesh-specific: a Bank Solvency Certificate is expected alongside the 6-month bank statement. Submission at the Embassy (4 Madani Avenue, Baridhara, Dhaka-1212), Sunday–Thursday 09:00–12:30. Confirm current fees and documents at the embassy site.

facts.claim: Nepali citizens need a C-3-9 short-term tourist visa for Korea (single entry, stay up to 90 days), applied for at the Korean Embassy in Kathmandu by online appointment. Single-entry fee NPR 5,400; processing about 21 working days.
facts.source_name: Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Nepal (MOFA)
facts.notes: Book an online appointment at koreanembassynepal.org (slots open Mondays and Wednesdays 10:00). Nepali documents must be translated into English and notarized; Korean documents must be originals issued within the last 3 months. Flight bookings should show departure at least 21 days after the application. Submitting fake tickets or false details can bring a rejection and a 3-year re-application ban. Confirm current fees/rules at the embassy.

facts.claim: Uzbekistani citizens need a C-3 short-term tourist visa for Korea (stay up to 90 days). Tourist applications are accepted only through travel agencies accredited by the Korean Embassy in Tashkent — independent/online submission is not available.

value.apply_via: travel agencies accredited by the Korean Embassy, Tashkent (agency list on the embassy site)

facts.source_name: Korean Embassy, Tashkent (consular process, via kun.uz reporting)
facts.notes: For tourist/visitor visas the embassy accepts documents only through accredited travel agencies listed on its official site; you cannot submit directly or online. Employment, some student, and government-program visas are submitted differently. Fees and processing times are not published in an accessible official source — confirm both with an accredited agency or the embassy before you plan.

facts.claim: Sri Lankan citizens need a C-3-9 short-term tourist visa for Korea (a paper visa, stay up to 90 days), applied for at the Korean Embassy in Colombo. Processing is a minimum of about 15 working days; the fee is paid in rupees at the embassy's current rate.

value.apply_at: Korean Embassy, Colombo (No. 98 Dharmapala Mawatha, Colombo 7)
value.fee: paid in LKR at the embassy's current rate

facts.source_name: Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Sri Lanka (MOFA)
facts.notes: This is a paper visa, not an e-visa. The fee is paid in rupees at the rate in the embassy's current 'Visa Fee Increase' notice — confirm the amount there. There is no express service (early issuance is only for diplomatic/official passports). Passport must be valid 6+ months with at least one blank page. Missing any required document can cause a rejection.

facts.claim: Pakistani citizens need a C-3 short-term tourist visa for Korea (stay up to 90 days), submitted at the Korean Embassy in Islamabad. Some applicants are called for an interview, and tourist-visa extensions are generally not granted.
facts.source_name: Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Pakistan (MOFA)
facts.notes: Applications are submitted at the Embassy in Islamabad; an interview may be requested to verify your file. Tourist-visa validity is usually 90 days and extensions are generally not granted. Fees and processing times are not published in an accessible official source — confirm both at the embassy before you plan.

facts.claim: Korea's emergency police number is 112.
facts.notes: Well-established number.

facts.claim: Korea's fire and emergency medical (ambulance) number is 119.
facts.notes: Well-established number.

facts.claim: The Korea Tourism Organization's travel help, interpretation and complaint line is 1330 (24 hours, multilingual).
facts.notes: Official KTO tourist information line.

facts.claim: The Immigration Contact Center is 1345 — a multilingual line for visa, stay and immigration questions (run by the Korea Immigration Service).
facts.notes: Dial 1345 without an area code inside Korea. For tourism info and interpretation, 1330 is the main line.

facts.claim: AREX Express train: non-stop between Incheon Airport and Seoul Station. About 43 min from Terminal 1 (51 min from Terminal 2).
facts.notes: The Express fare rose from the older ₩9,500; 2026 sources cite about ₩13,000 flat with online discounts near ₩11,500. Always confirm the current fare at arex.or.kr.

facts.claim: AREX all-stop train: reaches Seoul Station in about 59–66 minutes. Fare depends on your destination station.
facts.notes: Cheapest airport rail option; pay with T-money. Confirm the exact fare for your station at arex.or.kr.

facts.claim: Incheon Airport limousine / airport bus: about 60–90 minutes to Seoul, depending on route and traffic. Fare varies by bus type.
facts.notes: Premium KAL limousine buses cost more (~₩18,000); standard airport buses are cheaper. Buses stop near many hotels — check the route for your destination.

facts.claim: A regular metered taxi from Incheon Airport to central Seoul runs about ₩65,000–85,000 and takes 60–70 minutes. The official International Taxi offers fixed fares with certified English/Japanese/Chinese-speaking drivers.
facts.notes: Metered fares vary with traffic and destination and include expressway tolls; a late-night surcharge can apply. International Taxi desks are in the T1 and T2 arrivals halls (intltaxi.co.kr, +82-1644-2255).

facts.claim: T-money cards are sold and recharged at convenience stores nationwide (CU, GS25, 7-Eleven, Emart24) and at subway station machines.

value.stores: CU, GS25, 7-Eleven, Emart24, subway station machines

facts.notes: Works on subway, bus, taxi and at convenience stores.

facts.claim: T-money basic card price and refund policy.
facts.notes: Varies by store and design. The card fee itself is non-refundable (only the remaining balance is refundable). Confirm at the official t-money.co.kr.

facts.claim: KTX Seoul → Busan standard-seat one-way fare and approximate travel time.

value.booking: letskorail.com / KORAIL app, up to 1 month ahead

facts.notes: Third-party figure. Varies by train and seat class. Confirm the real fare at letskorail.com.

facts.claim: Seoul subway base fare is ₩1,550 with a T-money card (₩1,650 cash single ticket), for up to 10 km; longer trips add ₩100 per extra 5 km.
facts.notes: Raised from ₩1,400 in the June 2025 fare increase. Confirm current fares in Naver Map / KakaoMap or the Seoul TOPIS site.

facts.claim: Seoul city bus fares (T-money): blue & green ₩1,500, yellow ₩1,400, red (wide-area express) ₩3,000+, night (N-bus) ₩2,500.
facts.notes: Tap in AND out to get free transfers. Confirm current fares at Seoul TOPIS.

facts.claim: Seoul medium taxi base fare is ₩4,800 (first 1.6 km), then ₩100 per 132 m. A late-night surcharge of up to 40% applies (about 23:00–02:00). Deluxe taxis start at ₩7,000 (first 3 km) with no night surcharge.
facts.notes: Use Kakao T for an upfront fare estimate. Deluxe (mobeom) and international taxis cost more but avoid late-night surcharges / offer English.

facts.claim: Transfers between subway and bus (or bus and bus) are free within 30 minutes when you pay with a T-money card and tap both in and out.
facts.notes: You must tap out on the bus too, or you lose the transfer discount and may be charged again.

facts.claim: Three ways to get online in Korea: an eSIM (install before you fly, live the moment you land), a physical SIM (needs an unlocked phone), or a rental pocket Wi-Fi (best shared by a group). Carriers are SKT, KT and LG U+.
facts.notes: Prices vary widely by data amount and number of days, so compare current offers (e.g. Airalo/Klook for eSIM; carrier counters for SIM) rather than a fixed price. eSIM needs an eSIM-capable phone; a physical SIM needs an unlocked phone. Counters are in the Incheon T1/T2, Gimpo and Gimhae arrivals halls.

facts.claim: The best times to visit are spring (Mar–May) and autumn (Sep–Nov). Summer (Jun–Aug) is hot and humid with a monsoon; winter is cold and dry (Seoul averages about -2°C).
facts.source_name: General climate info / multiple travel guides
facts.notes: General seasonal characteristics. Cherry-blossom and fall-foliage dates shift each year.

facts.claim: Tipping is not customary in Korea; you don't need to tip at restaurants or in taxis.
facts.notes: Some luxury hotels may add a service charge, but generally no tip is expected.

facts.claim: Korea's currency is the won (KRW, ₩).
facts.notes: Cards are widely accepted; cash is handy for small vendors and traditional markets.

facts.claim: Myeongdong drew the highest average daily number of foreign visitors in Seoul (about 100,910), the city's most-visited area.
facts.notes: Average daily foreign visitors, per Seoul city reporting.

facts.claim: N Seoul Tower was Seoul's 2nd most-visited spot by foreign visitors (about 57,370 average daily).
facts.notes: Average daily foreign visitors, per Seoul city reporting.

facts.claim: Bukhansan had the most foreign hikers of Seoul's mountains (about 4,015), leading the growing 'K-hiking' trend.
facts.notes: Foreign hiker counts by Seoul mountain; Bukhansan highest.

facts.claim: Many nationalities can enter visa-free for tourism (length varies by country: 30/60/90 days).
facts.source_name: HiKorea (MOJ) / Visa policy of South Korea
facts.notes: Varies by country — do not generalize. Provide a per-country confirmation link in the UI.

facts.claim: Indian passport holders need a C-3-9 short-term tourist visa to visit Korea (up to 90 days). Apply in person at a Korea Visa Application Center (VFS Global) — no appointment needed.
facts.source_name: KVAC India (VFS Global) / Korea Visa Portal
facts.notes: Fees and processing vary by center and season — confirm at your KVAC. The form and any e-application are only at visa.go.kr (the only official portal). India is split into two jurisdictions: Embassy/New Delhi (visaforkorea-id.com) and Chennai Consulate (visaforkorea-ce.com).

facts.claim: Ordinary Vietnamese passport holders need a visa for a normal mainland tourist trip. Hanoi's current single-entry C-3-9 guide specifies a 30-day stay; follow the period actually granted on your visa.

value.max_stay: Hanoi single-entry: 30 days; follow the issued visa
value.apply_at: KVAC Hanoi / Ho Chi Minh City / Korean Consulate General in Da Nang

facts.notes: Apply through the office responsible for your residence: Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City or Da Nang. Eligibility and permitted stay vary by visa category. Confirm the current checklist with that office.

facts.claim: Chinese passport holders need a C-3 tourist visa for mainland Korea. Jeju Island allows visa-free entry up to 30 days (Jeju-only, direct flights).
facts.source_name: Travel guides (2026) — confirm at Korean embassy in China
facts.notes: A visa-free scheme for approved Chinese tour groups (3+) ran Sep 2025–Jun 2026; check whether it has been extended before relying on it. Jeju-only visa-free requires direct flights without mainland transit.

facts.claim: Filipino passport holders need a C-3-9 tourist visa for mainland Korea. For Filipino applicants: stays of 59 days or less have no visa issuance fee; stays of 60–90 days cost PHP 2,000. KVAC charges are separate; an agency may add a service fee. Effective 2026-10-01: ordinary C-3 processing is 12 working days; express applications remain 5 working days. Check express eligibility separately.

value.visa_fee: For Filipino applicants: stays of 59 days or less have no visa issuance fee; stays of 60–90 days cost PHP 2,000. KVAC charges are separate; an agency may add a service fee.
value.processing: Effective 2026-10-01: ordinary C-3 processing is 12 working days; express applications remain 5 working days. Check express eligibility separately.
value.apply_at: Submit through KVAC in the Philippines. Check the current KVAC instructions before visiting; the Embassy does not receive ordinary applications directly.

facts.source_name: Embassy of the Republic of Korea in the Philippines — tourist checklist
facts.notes: This is a summary, not a complete checklist. Students, freelancers, retirees, sponsored applicants and other categories must use their own section of the official checklist. Approval and entry are not guaranteed. Additional documents may be requested; the processing period may be recalculated after submission.

document_requirements.passport: Original passport and copy of the passport bio-page.
document_requirements.form: Use the visa application form attached to the Embassy’s official tourist-visa requirements. Follow the form instructions.
document_requirements.bank_certificate: Bank certificate: issued in your name within the last 3 months, showing account name, number, type, opening date, current balance and 6-month average daily balance (ADB).
document_requirements.employment: Employees: COE on company letterhead with position, salary, hired date, company address and HR phone/email, issued within the last 3 months; ITR (BIR Form 2316 or 1701).
document_requirements.business: Sole proprietors: DTI certificate, business/mayor’s permit and ITR (BIR Form 1701). Corporate applicants: SEC registration first page and GIS, mayor’s permit and ITR (BIR Form 1701 or 1702).
document_requirements.bank_statement_scope: The current tourist checklist lists a bank certificate, rather than a separate bank-statement item for ordinary employees. This is not a blanket exemption from financial evidence: follow your category and any additional request.
document_requirements.collection: Visit KVAC after receiving its SMS notice. Collect your passport and check the visa grant details.
document_requirements.photo: 3.5 cm × 4.5 cm; plain white background, taken within the last 6 months; no copies, selfies or altered photos.

facts.claim: Ordinary passports that require a tourist visa are not eligible for K-ETA for that visit. If your passport requires a visa for a normal mainland visit, K-ETA is not an alternative or an extra application after your visa. K-ETA age exemptions do not waive the visa requirement. Special group and Jeju programs have separate conditions. Trial: 2026-05-28 to 2026-12-31. Only groups of 3 or more recruited by designated Indonesian agencies qualify, with a maximum 15-day stay. Three independent friends do not qualify. The Korean partner must register the list through HiKorea 24 hours before air arrival or 36 hours before sea arrival and obtain pre-screening; travelers normally enter and leave together on the same flight or ship.
facts.notes: Visa: follow the issued grant; designated group program: 15 days

facts.claim: K-ETA-eligible travelers aged 17 and under or 65 and over are exempt from mandatory K-ETA. This does not itself exempt them from the e-Arrival Card.
facts.notes: Confirm your exact case on the official sites. Immigration makes the final entry decision.

facts.claim: Ordinary Vietnamese passports are not eligible for K-ETA. For a normal mainland tourist trip, obtain a visa; K-ETA cannot replace it and is not an extra application after receiving your visa.
facts.notes: Office-specific and conditional rules: confirm with the issuing authority before travel.

facts.claim: Published individual tourist processing times are 16 working days in Hanoi and 18 working days in Ho Chi Minh City. Weekends and holidays are excluded; additional checks can take longer. These are published estimates, not guaranteed deadlines. Da Nang applicants should confirm separately.
facts.notes: Office-specific and conditional rules: confirm with the issuing authority before travel.

facts.claim: Short-stay single-entry visa: USD 20; multiple-entry: USD 80. KVAC Hanoi and HCMC add VND 390,000 per application, excluding optional services. Confirm the payable currency and current total at your office; the KVAC service charge is not a Da Nang consular charge.
facts.notes: Office-specific and conditional rules: confirm with the issuing authority before travel.

sources.name: Korean Embassy · Vietnamese reciprocal visa fees

facts.claim: Apply according to your registered residence: KVAC Hanoi, KVAC Ho Chi Minh City, or the Korean Consulate General in Da Nang. Check the current jurisdiction and appointment instructions before visiting.
facts.source_name: Korean Consulate General in Da Nang
facts.notes: Da Nang Vietnamese FAQ names Hue, Da Nang and Quang Ngai; residence exceptions need proof. Hanoi guidance covers Quang Tri northwards. Confirm current province coverage and appointment requirements with the receiving office.

facts.claim: Use the checklist for your office and application category. Hanoi's current individual C-3-9 checklist requests bank statements for the latest 3 months, plus salary records for employees. Include residence and family documents when applicable; translation and certification requirements vary.
facts.notes: Office-specific and conditional rules: confirm with the issuing authority before travel.

facts.claim: A short-term tourist entering with a visa must submit the e-Arrival Card unless a separate exemption applies, such as holding a valid Korean residence card. Check the official navigator for your documents.
facts.notes: Office-specific and conditional rules: confirm with the issuing authority before travel.

facts.claim: Vietnamese ordinary-passport tourists can use the separate Jeju visa-free program for up to 30 days, subject to entry assessment. Arrive directly at Jeju from overseas by air or sea and stay on Jeju. An itinerary entering Korea through Seoul or Busan is not covered. Going to the mainland requires the appropriate visa or prior immigration permission; admission is not guaranteed.
facts.notes: Office-specific and conditional rules: confirm with the issuing authority before travel.

sources.name: Korean Embassy · Jeju eligibility and mainland restrictions

facts.claim: A qualifying visa or residence permit for the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand or a listed European country may allow B-2 transit for up to 30 days on an eligible onward/return route. A Japanese visa alone is not in the current third-country transit list. You need a confirmed departure within 30 days and must meet immigration-history, routing and visa-document conditions; merely owning a visa or taking a Vietnam–Korea round trip is insufficient. Verify your complete itinerary with immigration and the airline.
facts.notes: Official notice dated 2026-03-31. Qualifying US/Canada/Australia/New Zealand or specified European documents, onward ticket within 30 days, permitted route, visa verification, immigration history and stopover limits all apply. Japan alone is not listed. This is not a general visa waiver for a Vietnam–Korea return trip.

facts.claim: Ordinary passports that require a tourist visa are not eligible for K-ETA for that visit. If your passport requires a visa for a normal mainland visit, K-ETA is not an alternative or an extra application after your visa. K-ETA age exemptions do not waive the visa requirement. Special group and Jeju programs have separate conditions.
facts.notes: Confirm eligibility, current conditions and documents with the official authority before travel.

facts.claim: Eligible C-3-2 group visas for China, Vietnam, the Philippines, Indonesia, India and Cambodia have the USD 15 visa issuance fee waived through 2026-12-31. This is not visa-free entry or a waiver of individual visa fees, agency fees or service charges.
facts.notes: Confirm eligibility, current conditions and documents with the official authority before travel.

facts.claim: KVAC Jakarta estimates: single/double visa 10 working days, multiple visa 7, eligible C-3 express 5. Submission day is included; holidays are excluded. Extra documents or interviews can extend processing. Flight tickets and hotel reservations are not mandatory for visa assessment according to the official FAQ.
facts.notes: Confirm eligibility, current conditions and documents with the official authority before travel.

facts.claim: From 2026-07-01: short single-entry IDR 680,000 + KVAC IDR 240,000 = IDR 920,000; multiple-entry IDR 1,530,000 + IDR 240,000 = IDR 1,770,000. Express and optional services cost extra; confirm the current official table.
facts.notes: Confirm eligibility, current conditions and documents with the official authority before travel.

facts.claim: Eligible applicants can apply for 5- or 10-year multiple-entry visas; the KVAC table lists a 30-day stay per visit. Long validity does not mean continuous residence or automatic eligibility. Ask KVAC to check your category.
facts.notes: Confirm eligibility, current conditions and documents with the official authority before travel.

facts.claim: Indonesian ordinary-passport tourists may use Jeju's separate visa-free program for up to 30 days, arriving directly from overseas and staying on Jeju. Entry via mainland Korea is not covered. Mainland travel requires an appropriate visa or prior immigration permission; entry is assessed at the border.
facts.notes: Confirm eligibility, current conditions and documents with the official authority before travel.

facts.claim: KVAC Jakarta: Lotte Mall Ciputra World 1 Unit 5F-05A, 5th floor, Jl. Prof. DR. Satrio No.1, Jakarta Selatan 12940. Applications 09:00–15:00 WIB Monday–Friday except holidays.
facts.notes: Confirm eligibility, current conditions and documents with the official authority before travel.

value.address: Lotte Mall Ciputra World 1, Unit 5F-05A, Jl. Prof. DR. Satrio No. 1, Jakarta Selatan 12940

facts.claim: KVAC charges PHP 1,000 per applicant, effective 2026-08-25. Pay in cash; this is separate from any Embassy visa issuance fee and optional agency or delivery charges. Fees are non-refundable, regardless of the decision.
facts.notes: Scope: visa applications submitted through KVAC in the Philippines.

facts.claim: Visit KVAC on the next working day after receiving its SMS notification. For personal collection, bring your valid government ID and the application receipt with barcode. A third-party collector needs additional authorization documents; check KVAC instructions.
facts.notes: Scope: visa applications submitted through KVAC in the Philippines.

facts.claim: No. KVAC says a tentative flight date and hotel name are sufficient; confirmed flight tickets and hotel reservations are not required for the application. KVAC does not set a fixed minimum balance. Your funds must cover your intended stay. This does not remove the financial-document requirements for your application category.
facts.notes: Scope: visa applications submitted through KVAC in the Philippines.

facts.claim: Ordinary-passport tourist visa applications go through KVAC Jakarta. Direct Embassy applications are reserved for diplomatic/official categories and specified exceptional cases; do not go directly to the Embassy for a normal tourist application.
facts.notes: Scope: ordinary-passport tourist applications through KVAC Jakarta.

facts.claim: KVAC Jakarta operates cashless in 2026. Use bank transfer, debit card or QRIS. The visa issuance fee and KVAC service charge are separate; check the current fee table before applying.
facts.notes: Scope: ordinary-passport tourist applications through KVAC Jakarta.

facts.claim: The KVAC tourist checklist includes a copy of the Indonesian family card (Kartu Keluarga). Employees provide an original employment certificate; students an original enrollment certificate; business owners a copy of the business license; homemakers and retirees a copy of KTP. Use the checklist for your category; additional documents may be requested. Original bank transaction details for the last 3 months, issued by your bank with its wet stamp. 1 photo, 3.5 × 4.5 cm, white background, attached to the application form.
facts.notes: Scope: ordinary-passport tourist applications through KVAC Jakarta.

facts.claim: Monday–Friday, excluding holidays: applications 09:00–15:00 WIB; passport collection 12:00–17:00 WIB. Submission and collection have different hours. Check holiday notices before visiting.
facts.notes: Scope: ordinary-passport tourist applications through KVAC Jakarta.
